question: When an AI reads your message, what does it break the text into first?
teachLine: Language models chop text into tokens — little pieces roughly the size of a word or word-part. Everything it reads or writes is built from these building blocks.
callbackFact: LLMs process text by splitting it into tokens, which are units roughly the size of words or sub-word fragments, not whole sentences or sound.
